# `net` standard library

The `net` module provides POSIX socket wrappers for TCP and UDP communication on Linux systems.
The submodule `net/http` provides HTTP protocol parsing, header manipulation, and response generation.

```dva run
#use io
#use net
#use net/http
```

## Socket operations

Socket helpers return recoverable `Conn` (`< Int | String >`) ramifications rather than poisonous abort errors.

```dva run
#use io
#use net

// Create a listening TCP socket on port 8080
listener = net::tcp_listen(8080, 128)
listener
   | fd =>
      io::out(("Listening on fd", fd))
   | err =>
      io::err(("Listen error:", err))
```

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `net::tcp_listen` | `Int, Int => Conn` | Creates and binds listening TCP socket on IPv4 port |
| `net::tcp_accept` | `Int => Conn` | Accepts client connection: `< client_fd \| error >` |
| `net::tcp_connect` | `String, Int => Conn` | Connects to remote IPv4 host and port |
| `net::tcp_connect_name` | `String, Int => Conn` | Connects via DNS name lookup using `getaddrinfo` |
| `net::send_str` | `Int, String => Int` | Sends string bytes over socket |
| `net::recv` | `Int, Int => Chunk` | Reads up to `max` bytes into Chunk (`< String \| >`) |
| `net::close_fd` | `Int => ()` | Closes socket descriptor |
| `net::set_nonblocking` | `Int, Int => Int` | Sets non-blocking socket flag (`O_NONBLOCK` when 1, blocking when 0) |
| `net::peer_addr` | `Int => String` | Returns remote peer address `IP:port` formatted string |
| `net::local_addr` | `Int => String` | Returns local bound address `IP:port` formatted string |

## HTTP protocol support (`net/http`)

The `net/http` submodule parses HTTP/1.1 requests and formats responses:

```dva run
#use io
#use net/http

req = "GET /index.html?v=1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n"
path = http::path_of(req) // "/index.html"

// Construct standard HTTP response with pre-formatted headers:
body = "Hello, World!"
headers = http::header("Content-Type", "text/plain") +
          http::header("Content-Length", str::from_int(?body))
res = http::response(200, headers, body)
```

- `http::path_of(req: String) => String`: Extracts the normalized request target path.
- `http::reason_of(code: Int) => String`: Maps status code (e.g. `200`, `404`) to reason phrase (`"OK"`, `"Not Found"`).
- `http::header(name: String, value: String) => String`: Generates `Name: Value\r\n` line.
- `http::response(status: Int, headers: String, body: String) => String`: Constructs complete HTTP message: status line, headers, blank line separator, and body.
- `http::respond(fd: Int, status: Int, headers: String, body: String) => Int`: Writes HTTP response to client socket; returns total bytes written.
